elements.name: Jon Beesley
elements.features: Short, receding dark brown hair; clean-shaven, no glasses, average-to-stocky build.

voice.instructions: Use a mature male, mid-low register with a measured pace, neutral American accent, and a steady, lightly gravelly timbre; keep the delivery calm and precise, like a pilot making clear routine calls.
voice.descriptor: Mature male voice, mid-to-low pitch, measured pace, neutral American accent, and a steady, lightly gravelly timbre; calm, precise pilot delivery.
voice.why: Ash’s low, dry, measured character fits the requested mature, composed pilot delivery.
voice.sample_text: My name is Jon Beesley. The opening eight seconds show AA-1, the first prototype F-35A Lightning II, accelerating along the runway at Lockheed Martin’s Fort Worth, Texas, facility at 12:44 p.m.

elements.name: Lockheed Martin’s Fort Worth, Texas, facility

voice.instructions: Deliver with mature warmth, a calm low register, neutral American accent colouring, and clear, unhurried documentary pacing.
voice.descriptor: a calm documentary narrator for this film: measured, clear, unhurried
voice.why: Sage’s calm, low voice supports a composed documentary narration without sounding overly dramatic.
voice.sample_text: AA-1: First Flight. A short film from the record.

fixtures.detail: A blue rectangular entrance canopy with white LOCKHEED MARTIN lettering and star emblem.
fixtures.name: Entrance canopy

fixtures.detail: Dark glazed entrance doors beneath the canopy, reached by stone-faced steps with metal handrails.
fixtures.name: Main entrance

fixtures.detail: A broad bank of dark-tinted windows above the entrance canopy.
fixtures.name: Upper windows

fixtures.detail: A continuous band of dark ground-level glazing divided by pale vertical supports.
fixtures.name: Ground-floor windows

fixtures.detail: Three gray aircraft models angled upward on tall curved pale-gray supports.
fixtures.name: Aircraft display group

fixtures.detail: Several gray aircraft models angled across the facade on tall curved supports, with the outermost display partly cropped.
fixtures.name: Aircraft display group

fixtures.detail: An open metal globe sculpture formed from intersecting rings, mounted above a narrow central support.
fixtures.name: Globe sculpture

fixtures.detail: A tall slender flagpole flying a United States flag above the entrance.
fixtures.name: American flagpole

fixtures.detail: A row of slender poles flying assorted national flags across the front of the building; the far-left pole is cropped.
fixtures.name: Left flagpole

fixtures.detail: Multiple slender flagpoles with differently coloured national flags extending toward the right edge.
fixtures.name: National flag display

fixtures.detail: Broad pale concrete steps leading to the raised plaza, divided and bordered by silver metal handrails.
fixtures.name: Central plaza steps

fixtures.detail: Additional pale steps and sloped access areas with silver tubular railings.
fixtures.name: Right plaza access

fixtures.detail: Low white angular retaining walls surrounding raised planting beds.
fixtures.name: Left planter walls

fixtures.detail: White rectangular retaining walls enclosing low green planting.
fixtures.name: Central planter walls

fixtures.detail: A long low white wall bearing dark lettering reading “We never forget who we're working for.”
fixtures.name: Inscribed plaza wall

fixtures.detail: Low green shrubs and groundcover planted along the building and around the display supports.
fixtures.name: Landscaped beds

fort-worth-facility.light: Strong direct daylight under a clear blue sky; bright pale surfaces, sharp shadows beneath the canopy and aircraft displays, and dark reflective glazing.
fort-worth-facility.floor: Gray paved roadway across the foreground, edged by a red-painted curb; narrow grass strips, pale concrete plaza paving and steps, and stone-faced entrance steps.
fort-worth-facility.walls: Exterior facade of pale cream concrete panels with tall recessed rectangular detailing, white vertical structural divisions and a broad white roof fascia. Dark-tinted glazing runs along the lower facade and forms a large upper window bank above the entrance.

fixtures.detail: A long rectangular table with a plain grey top and four slim grey metal legs.
fixtures.name: Table

fixtures.detail: Four chairs arranged along the left wall, with pale honey-coloured wooden seats and backs on slender dark metal frames.
fixtures.name: Row of four chairs

fixtures.detail: A single pale wooden chair with a dark metal frame, angled toward the table beside its right end.
fixtures.name: Chair beside table

fixtures.detail: Three pale honey-coloured wooden chairs with slender dark metal frames, arranged along the right wall.
fixtures.name: Row of three chairs

flight-test-airspace.light: Soft, diffuse daylight, brighter from the left, with gentle shadows beneath the furniture. No light fixtures are visible.
flight-test-airspace.floor: Brown wood-effect flooring with visible grain and plank seams, with a slightly reflective finish.
flight-test-airspace.walls: Plain, smooth off-white walls with narrow white skirting boards; an unadorned off-white ceiling. No visible doors, windows, or wall decorations.
